title: Pause stop hide for content over five seconds
statement:
Any moving, blinking, or scrolling information that starts automatically and lasts longer than five seconds must include a mechanism for the user to pause, stop, or hide it.

Options:
- Explicit Control: Visible Play/Pause button (fits: hero carousels, background videos)
- Passive Compliance: Auto-stop after 4 seconds (fits: toast notifications, success animations)
- Interactive Pausing: Hover/Focus to pause (fits: news tickers, scrolling logos)
appliesWhen: Applies to: carousels, video backgrounds, tickers. Audience: general.
